findings.finding: Six cells show three distinct front/back adult character proposals. Sena, Kaem and Lyd retain distinct clothing/props; no official insignia or magical proof device. Young adult presentation remains a design proposal.

Mill wheel, grain sacks partly screening shelves, distant charred frame, separate outdoor rain awning/table and open central return aisle are visible. Shelves hold more books than the modest brief implies; do not use decorative quantity as recovered stock/capacity. No thriving academy is depicted.

Two sheets on the comparison table have visible left-edge binding holes and different widths; closed storage and a sealed cabinet are present. Finite peripheral room and clear front exit read well. The margin difference is subtle at room scale: use a dedicated close-up for any clue interaction, rather than treating this room image as proof of the trimmed annotation or private folio contents.

Correction verified: upper-right contains one impression press/workbench with paper trays and one stool instead of classroom rows; upper-left brazier is cold ash. Four functionally distinct compartments surround an open central yard, and an outer bypass with gates remains legible. Gate states, safe collision and maintenance-return connectivity still require implementation testing.

Correction verified: exactly two sheets and three left-margin holes per sheet in each of four frames; no mirrored right-margin holes. Chipped versus straight right edge remains distinguishable. Hole spacing/vertical placement and page geometry still drift between frames, so the image supports the comparison gesture but not mechanically exact matching-hole alignment or a ready animation. Physical comparison alone does not certify NE2.

overall: Selected batch09 images are usable review concepts with documented clue-scale and continuity caveats. Major 44/45 count and narrative corrections pass independent review; no engine-readiness claim.
